players.bio: Caylan David Vickers is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Burton Albion.

Charles Clive Webster (born 31 January 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Burton Albion. Webster came through the Chelsea academy but never made a first team appearance.
Ciaran Patrick Gilligan (born 19 January 2002) is an Irish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Burton Albion.
Corey Addai is a 28-year-old professional football goalkeeper who plays for EFL League One club Burton Albion, on a season-long loan from parent club Stockport County.

Curtis Anthony Tilt (born 4 August 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Burton Albion. Born in England, he represented Jamaica at international level. Born in Walsall, Tilt spent his early career with Halesowen Town, Hednesford Town and AFC Telford United. He signed for Wrexham in June 2016, moving on loan to Forest Green Rovers in March 2017.
Finn Anthony Delap (born 10 June 2005) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Burton Albion.
Gary David Bowyer (born 22 June 1971) is an English professional football coach and former player who is the manager of Burton Albion.
Gbemi Kingslyn Arubi is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Burton Albion.
Harvey Araujo is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Burton Albion.
Jack Armer (born 16 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays for Burton Albion as a defender.Born in England, he has represented Scotland at youth international level.

Jason Robert Sraha Osei (born 19 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Burton Albion. Sraha is a product of the youth academy of Chelsea, and moved to Arsenal's academy on 8 July 2019. On 29 June 2021, Sraha signed with Barnsley after being released by Arsenal.
Joe Cameron Lewis (born 20 September 1999) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays for Burton Albion as a defender.
Kain James Kofi Adom is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Burton Albion.
Kamil Dudek is a 20-year-old Polish professional football player who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Burton Albion F.C..
Kgaogelo "Kegs" Chauke (born 8 January 2003) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for League One club Burton Albion.
Kyran Aiden Lofthouse (born 15 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right midfielder for EFL League One club Burton Albion.
Mark O'Mahony is a 21-year-old Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Burton Albion, on loan from Premier League side Brighton & Hove Albion.
Matthew Timothy Dennis (born 15 April 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Burton Albion.

Raphael Borges Rodrigues (born 11 September 2003) is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Burton Albion on loan from Premier League club Coventry City. Born in the Netherlands, he represents Australia at youth international level.
Sulyman Krubally (Sulyman Krubally Sankareh) is an 18-year-old professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Burton Albion F.C. in EFL League One.

Toby Peter Sibbick (born 23 May 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for EFL League One club Burton Albion. Born in England, he plays for the Uganda national team. He has previously played for AFC Wimbledon and Barnsley, as well as spending a short spell on loan at Hearts before signing permanently.

English central midfielder Will Collar plays for the EFL League One football club Burton Albion, on loan from Milton Keynes Dons. Career Brighton & Hove Albion He made his debut for Brighton on 28 August 2018, in the EFL Cup at home against Southampton where he played the full match in a 1–0 loss against their south coast rivals.
